# GfxMode3DHeight <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Display](Blitz3D-Display)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GfxMode3DHeight:Int32 mode:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | In | Int32 | required | Number of the mode, 1 to [CountGfxModes3D](CountGfxModes3D). |

**Returns:** The height in pixels.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

The height in pixels of a mode from the list of 3D modes. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no way to ask a 3D mode for its size, other than [GfxModeHeight](GfxModeHeight) for the same number. A mode number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
